issue: terminal task could remain visible before the in-process execution slot was released

initial_reproduction.failure: test_worker_base_exception_becomes_terminal_and_releases_slot returned BUSY immediately after failed became visible

repair_1.change: release the semaphore immediately before starting the terminal store transaction
repair_1.diagnosis: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE status polling could starve the terminal write after the slot was released outside the transaction; a separate cold-import failure and Windows faulthandler crash were retained as environment evidence

repair_2.change: release the local semaphore through a before_commit callback while the terminal transaction still holds its database lock
